   - The grid is \(3 \times 9\), divided into three vertical \(3 \times 3\) blocks (Columns 1-3, 4-6, 7-9).

   - For each row \(i\) (0-indexed), the elements from blocks \(M_1\), \(M_2\), and \(M_3\) must form a permutation. This means the union of the elements from each block's \(i\)-th row must be exactly \(\{1, 2, \ldots, 9\}\).
